# Alpha Studio brand book

This book is for anyone who makes something for Alpha Studio: a page, a post or a slide. [[on-a-page-scope]]

## Alpha Studio on a page {#on-a-page}

Alpha Studio sounds calm and looks quiet. Two things make it known: the blue round mark and the line "We make calm
software." [[on-a-page-assets]]

## Who Alpha Studio is {#who}

Alpha Studio builds small, calm tools for teams who run a shop on their own. [[who-what]] Its three words are calm,
plain and steady. [[who-values]]

## Voice {#voice}

Short sentences and plain words, as the site itself writes. [[voice-lede, voice-team]]

| Do | Do not |
|---|---|
| "We make calm software." [[voice-lede]] | *We make the most powerful software ever made.* |
| "Start" [[voice-cta]] | *Click here to begin your journey* |

Never shout. [[voice-never]]

## Logo {#logo}

The round mark is the logo. Use the file as it is, on the page colour or on the text colour. [[logo-mark]]

[[specimen: logo]]

## Colour {#colour}

Blue #1d4ed8 is the accent, for actions only. [[colour-accent]] In dark mode the page is #0b0b0f.

## Typography {#type}

All text is set in Arial. [[type-sans]]

## Imagery {#imagery}

The home page has one thin teal stripe as decoration. [[imagery-stripe]]

Which photographs or illustrations the brand uses is still open. [[open: G1]]

## The brand in use {#in-use}

The home page opens on one headline, one line and one button. [[in-use-hero]]

## Files and care {#care}

The colours live in `app/globals.css` and nowhere else. [[care-tokens]] The logo is `files/logo-mark.svg`.
